apex_lang.hero_text: Apex is a programming language built for speed, power, simplicity, clarity, readability, and modernity.
apex_lang.simplicity_desc: Clean, indentation-based syntax with no braces or semicolons. Designed to be readable and easy to learn.
apex_lang.builtin_desc: Comes with a comprehensive standard library (os, sys, math, string, table, random, json, xml, csv, base, regex, crypto, zip, datetime) out of the box.
apex_lang.performance_desc: Written in C with a register-based virtual machine, NaN-boxing, optimized bytecode execution, and an x86-64 JIT compiler.
apex_lang.bundle_desc: Use apex build to compile your source to bytecode and embed it with the interpreter for instant startup.
apex_lang.benchmarks_desc: Apex is a fast language thanks to its register-based VM, nan-boxing, and an optional JIT compiler. Below are comparisons against other high-performance runtimes, grouped by execution mode. The bar widths represent relative execution time (slowest = 100% baseline).
apex_lang.benchmarks_footer: * Measured on Intel i5-12400F, Ubuntu 26.04 LTS, single-core. Lower bars = faster. LuaJIT runs with the JIT enabled in the JIT group and with -j off in the interpreted group.

apex_obfuscator.hero_text: Apex Obfuscator is a lightweight cipher with authenticated HMAC and streaming encryption.
apex_obfuscator.minimal_desc: Pure C implementation with zero external dependencies and minimal codebase.
apex_obfuscator.auth_desc: HMAC-SHA256 integrity verification detects any tampering or corruption.
apex_obfuscator.stream_desc: Encrypts and decrypts large files in chunks without loading everything into memory.
apex_obfuscator.memory_desc: Secure zeroization wipes sensitive keys and data immediately after use.
